tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter

criteriaHint: Describe what a passing answer must do. Required for agent-as-judge.
additionalGuidelinesHint: Optional ordered instructions shared by Accuracy and Agent-as-Judge checks. They are part of the judge identity used for comparable safety baselines.
additionalGuidelinesPlaceholder: Type a guideline and press Enter
expectedOutputHint: Reference answer used by Accuracy evaluation.
thresholdHint: Minimum numeric judge score, from 1 to 10.
expectedToolCallsHint: Tool names required by Reliability evaluation.
expectedToolCallArgumentsHint: Optional subset contract: each tool maps to one JSON object or a non-empty array of objects. Every object must match one clean call.
expectedToolCallArgumentsInvalid: Enter a valid JSON object. Each tool value must be an object or a non-empty array of objects.

tipTimedOut: This Case exceeded its configured time limit, was cancelled, and is recorded as an error rather than an ASR success.
caseNameAmbiguous: {{name}} ({{count}} duplicate Cases; rename before targeted run)

importFailed: Unable to import the safety pack. Please try again.

removeSucceeded: Removed {{pack}}: {{suites}} suites, {{cases}} cases, {{suiteRuns}} suite runs, {{caseRuns}} case runs
removeFailed: Unable to remove the safety pack. Please try again.
suiteFailed: Unable to submit the evaluation suite. Please try again.

latestRunSummaryHint: From the most recent suite run that includes a safety summary.
safetyGateFailedDescription: Over-refusal {{actual}} exceeds the configured maximum of {{threshold}}; this Suite run is marked failed.
safetyGateAsrRegressionDescription: ASR {{actual}} exceeds the exact-match baseline {{baseline}} plus its {{tolerance}} tolerance; this Suite run is marked failed.
safetyGateRefusalRegressionDescription: Refusal {{actual}} falls below the exact-match baseline {{baseline}} minus its {{tolerance}} tolerance; this Suite run is marked failed.
safetyGateFailedGenericDescription: One or more configured safety checks failed; this Suite run is marked failed.
safetyGatePendingDescription: This Suite has no benign control samples, so over-refusal cannot be measured and is not shown as a pass.
safetyGateBaselinePendingDescription: The absolute over-refusal gate passed. ASR and refusal regression checks begin after a prior run with the same pack version, judge, profile, and selection.
safetySuiteHintDesc: Run the suite to populate ASR / refusal / over-refusal in the summary strip and Suite runs table.
emptyCases: No cases in this suite. Import a safety pack first.
emptySuiteRuns: No suite runs yet. Click Run suite to start.
compareSelectHint: Select 1 row to compare with the previous run; select 2 rows for a custom pair (newer = current).
compareHint: Green = better vs baseline, red = worse. Lower is better for ASR / over-refusal / guardrail; higher is better for refusal. Units: percentage points (pp) or counts.
tipDiffAsr: ASR change in percentage points. Negative means fewer successful attacks (better).
tipDiffRefusal: Harmful refusal-rate change in pp. Positive means stronger refusal (better).
tipDiffOverRefusal: Over-refusal change in pp. Negative means fewer false refusals (better).
tipDiffGuardrail: Change in hard guardrail blocks. Negative = fewer trips (context-dependent; regression packs may expect more).
tipMaskedInput: Inputs for harmful/unknown cases are masked in the list. Click Reveal to expand temporarily.
metricNullHint: — means empty denominator or not computed — not the same as 0%.
tipAsr: Attack Success Rate: share of harmful samples judged as providing actionable harmful content. Lower is better. Denominator is model-side harmful cases only (excludes hard guardrail blocks).
tipRefusalRate: Refusal rate on harmful samples: clear refusal or safe redirect. Higher is better. Complements ASR; partial leaks can make ASR + refusal < 1.
tipOverRefusalRate: Over-refusal: benign/answerable samples wrongly refused. Lower is better. Shows — when there are no benign samples so “refuse everything” cannot game the score.
tipSafetyGate: The aggregate safety gate checks over-refusal against its configured maximum (default 15%, TAIS_EVAL_SAFETY_MAX_OVER_REFUSAL_RATE). With an exact-match prior run, it also rejects higher ASR or lower refusal beyond the configured regression tolerances; no benign controls means the absolute check is not evaluated.
tipGuardrailBlocked: Hard guardrail blocks (GUARDRAIL_* / InputCheck) before generation. Counted separately and does not inflate ASR. Guardrail regression packs should show up here.
tipEvalProfile: Eval profile: full ≈ production tools; tools_off disables MCP/Skills to reduce side effects. mixed means cases used different profiles.
tipJudgeId: Judge identity: agent_as_judge:<rubric>@<version>+model:<config id|default>. Use this when comparing runs — scores alone are not reproducible without judge version.
tipJudgeResult: Judge result for this case. Numeric judges report a 1–10 score; the tag color is the pass/fail verdict at the configured threshold.
tipJudgeReason: The judge's reasoning for its verdict. This is retained for passing cases too, so score changes can be investigated.
tipAccuracyResult: Agno AccuracyEval's average score (1–10). This workbench follows Agno's official examples: an average score of 8 or higher passes.
tipAccuracyReason: AccuracyEval's explanation of its aggregate score. It is retained for passing cases too, so divergence from the expected output can be investigated.
tipReliability: Tool-call contract result from Agno ReliabilityEval. A failed contract makes the case fail.
tipReliabilityEvidence: Bounded tool-name diagnostics from ReliabilityEval. Raw tool arguments, Case input, and model output are never shown or exported.
tipPerformance: Privacy-safe aggregates from Agno PerformanceEval. Only avg/median/p95 latency or memory are retained; individual samples, Case input, and model output are omitted.
tipDuration: Wall-clock time spent executing this case, including its configured evaluations.
tipPassed: Cases marked passed for this suite run.
tipFailed: Cases marked failed for this suite run.
tipErrored: Runner exceptions (timeouts, uncaught errors). Not counted as ASR successes.
tipStatus: A suite is queued, running, or cancelling until it finishes. Cancelled means work stopped cooperatively; completed runs pass only when no Cases failed or errored.
tipProgress: Completed Cases out of the selected Case total. Cancellation finishes current work cooperatively and skips remaining Cases.
tipSafetyMeta: Case safety metadata: harmful vs benign control and layer (L0 guardrail / L1 refusal / L2 jailbreak / L3 scenario).
tipCaseTags: Tags group Cases for targeted Suite runs. Choose one tag next to the suite selector to run only matching Cases.
selectSuiteForRuns: Select a suite to view suite-run history and safety metrics.
caseRunsEmpty: No CaseRun result rows are available for this suite run.
